iti108:2.1: unnaḷā → unnalā (pts) | siṅgī → siṅgi, D. E. P. Pa. sīgīti, Aa.; siṅgā, B. C. M.; it seems to be a derivate of saṅgo; the MS. of A. is corrupt in the beginning, the end of the comment is: evaṁvuttehi saṁgha (sic !) -sadisehi pākaṭakilesehi samannāgatā. (pts note) | unnalā → unnaḷā, M. (pts note) | me → na ca te, C. (pts note)
iti108:2.2: vuddhiṁ → vuḍḍhiṁ (sya-all) | te → na ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū (cck: sī. pī. ka.) | apagatā → apāgatā, C. (pts note) | na → Om. D. E. (pts note) | bhikkhū → Om. B. C. P. Pa. (pts note) | virūḷhiṁ → viruḷhiṁ, B. M. P. Pa. (without ṁ, B. Pa.) (pts note)
iti108:2.3: te → te ca (sya-all, pts) | kho → kho te, D. E. P. Pa. (pts note) | athaddhā → I follow B. C. M., cp. the second gāthā; P. has asandhā, Pa. abandhā, instead of athaddhā; D. E. have nikko- nitthaddhā nilapā dhī- ābandhā sus-; A. does not explain the sukhapakkho in detail. (pts note) | ca → Om. M. Pa. (pts note) | me → Om. B. C. P. Pa. (pts note)
iti108:2.4: te → te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṁ (bj) | imasmiṁ →  (bj) | vuddhiṁ → vuḍḍhiṁ (sya-all) | ca → ca bhikkhave bhikkhū (pts) | dhammavinaye → imasmiṁ ca te dhammavinaye (cck: syā.); te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṁ dhammavinaye (cck: ka.) | imasmā → imasmā, D. E.; imamhā, B. C. M. P.; Pa. om. im- and the following words up to imasmiṁ. (pts note) | ca → te ca by conjecture; ca te, P.; na ca te, C.; te, without ca, B. M., but B. inserts ca after imasmi; D. E. have imasmiñca te dhammavinaye (without bhikkhave bhikkhū). (pts note) | virūḷhiṁ → viruḷhim, B. M. P. Pa. (without ṁ, B. P. Pa.). (pts note)

iti108:3.3: virūhanti → virūhanti only M.; virūḷhanti, B. C. D. E. P. (B. P. with u). (pts note)
